basis: SKOLEM_LOCAL_DERIVATION_V1 allows CONST, AFFINE_XOR, EXISTING_DAG_NODE, GUARDED_ITE with hash-consed sharing.
V1.1 bridge preserves these forms and states GUARDED_ITE(g, Pi_true, Pi_false) for an exact complementary split g / NOT g.
The frozen bridge text does not restrict g to a raw boundary variable; the prior tiny bridge checker used raw variables only as an implementation of that specific tiny control.
frozen_semantics_binding.binding: A previously locally checked Boolean derivation root may be referenced as g in a later GUARDED_ITE node. This is a reference/composition discipline inside the existing GUARDED_ITE rule form, not a new rule form.
frozen_semantics_binding.complement_contract: No explicit NOT rule is introduced. Complement is represented by swapping constant children under the same exact guard: NOT O := GUARDED_ITE(O,0,1).
frozen_semantics_binding.nonlinear_xor_contract: No XOR-of-DAG-nodes rule is introduced. A XOR O is represented as GUARDED_ITE(A, NOT O, O).

affine_only.targeted_counterexample: a=b=0, c=1, all other boundary bits 0 gives A=0, O=1, G=1

or3_only.targeted_counterexample: a=1,b=0,c=1, all other boundary bits 0 gives A=1, O=1, G=0

failure_interpretation.note: If the frozen builder/verifier cannot realize the preregistered mixed guard using only the bound semantics above, stop before hostile constructor.
